model_annotation: The bar chart displays the number of participants associated with each criterion, arranged vertically along the y-axis labeled "Criterion" and horizontally along the x-axis labeled "Number of Participants," which ranges from 0 to 6 in increments of 2. The criteria, listed from top to bottom, are: "Relevant FCs," "FC Summary," "R," "Clarity and Simplicity," "Overall Summary," "Filters," and "Veracity Explanation." Each criterion is represented by a horizontal bar of a distinct color, with the length corresponding to the number of participants, indicated by a numerical label at the end of each bar. The longest bar corresponds to "Relevant FCs" (dark purple, value 6), followed by "FC Summary" (dark blue, value 5). "R" and "Clarity and Simplicity" both have bars of equal length (teal and medium blue, value 3). "Overall Summary" (green, value 2) is shorter, while "Filters" and "Veracity Explanation" (light green and lime green, both value 1) are the shortest bars. The bars are sorted in descending order of participant count, and no additional visual emphasis such as shading or annotations is applied.
